title: KlassApp
description: A modern learning platform for students and educators.
content: A web platform designed to improve learning access and classroom interaction through structured course delivery and user-friendly navigation.

title: E-commerce Platform
description: A local marketplace connecting nearby buyers and sellers.
content: A location-based e-commerce system that allows users to discover and purchase nearby products. It includes distance-based product matching and real-time notifications for newly listed items in a user's area.

title: Afro Invest
description: A secure investment platform for African SMEs and investors.
content: A full-stack PERN application (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js, Prisma ORM) for managing investments, portfolios, and transactions with strong validation and scalable architecture.

title: UtilityBlocks
description: A decentralized utility payment system for fast, transparent transactions.
content: A blockchain-inspired utility payment platform where service providers register services and wallets, allowing users to pay directly with low fees, transparency, and improved transaction speed across multiple utility categories.
